characterization.name: GWP100 using selected central factors from IPCC AR6 WGI Table 7.15 as replaced by errata version 7 October 2025
characterization.outputUnit: kg CO2-eq per specified 100 m2 / ten-year service
characterization.sourceStatus: official indexed full-table text inspected; direct source bytes and visual PDF unavailable (403 / screenshot failure); original-PDF SHA-256 remains null
characterization.reportedCH4Uncertainty: 28.1 ± 10.4; not propagated in this one-parameter example; no interpretation of the ± statistic claimed here
characterization.scope: Fixed selected factor version and 100-year pulse metric; not a universal current reporting default; not observed local injury, temperature or endpoint damage

uncertainty.meaning: Unknown fixed fossil CO2 inventory intensity of the one shared electricity supply model, conditional on this exercise's stationary supply scenario
uncertainty.sharedRelation: Exactly the same theta applies to both alternatives and both substrate scenarios; it is not two independent unknowns
uncertainty.interpretation: Epistemic bounded parameter exercise, neither individual variability nor an estimated population mean; not a distribution, sampling interval, or statistical test

comparison.estimand: Delta_S(theta)=I_B,S(theta)-I_A,S(theta), characterized indicator difference for one whole specified service under substrate S and a common theta
comparison.toleranceUnit: kg CO2-eq per 100 m2 / ten-year service
comparison.toleranceStatus: AUTHOR-INVENTED predeclared didactic decision criterion; no empirical or stakeholder endorsement; deliberately coarse so robust tolerance and unresolved sign can coexist
comparison.strictOrdering: B lower only if all admissible Delta<0; A lower only if all admissible Delta>0
comparison.boundedEquivalence: For this one metric/model only: all admissible |Delta|<=4; evaluate paired Delta directly, never marginal-interval overlap
comparison.predeclaration: This published version fixes the author-invented tolerance and predicates as part of the teaching specification; it is not a preregistered experiment or stakeholder-endorsed criterion.
